legacy_conversion.gate: Pre-2018 CCE marksheets ONLY — the tool must require the user to confirm this.
legacy_conversion.note: Official source: CBSE Circular No. 24/2010 (28-05-2010); result explicitly called an INDICATIVE percentage. 9.5 came from CBSE's analysis that A1-band students averaged ~95 marks (95 ÷ 10 = 9.5), so 10 CGPA = 95%, NOT 100%.

name: India — CBSE (legacy CCE CGPA)
notes: CBSE × 9.5 is HISTORICAL ONLY. CCE was abolished March 2017 (Uniform System of Assessment from 2017–18; Class 10 board exams restored 2018). Current marksheets show subject marks + positional grades (A1–D2, E = Essential Repeat) — NO CGPA, NO grade points, NOTHING to convert. For current CBSE marksheets use percentage = marks ÷ total (the _default fallback).

sources.label: CBSE Circular No. 24/2010 — CGPA × 9.5 indicative percentage (via icbse.com)
CBSE CCE abolition — Uniform System of Assessment from 2017–18 (india.com)

traps: CBSE × 9.5 applies to PRE-2018 CCE marksheets ONLY — never to current marksheets.
10 CGPA = 95%, not 100% — the result is indicative, not exact.
